name: narxnoma
description: Price-fetch engine for Uzbekistan's electronics retailers: verified clients, API notes and traps for uzum, alifshop, beemarket, idea, mediapark, olcha, texnomart, asaxiy, radius, glotr and openshop, plus the name-to-product matcher and a market-research tool that turns a product list into an analysable Excel workbook (tables, formulas, heat map, PivotTables).
